newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen lower in early trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen lower in early trading.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open lower on Tuesday on a weaker bond market before the market focuses attention on Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's Congressional testimony at 1500 GMT.
"If we get past his testimony without shock waves, the market should do better," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
"It's been 400 (Dow) points since his 'irrational exuberance' comments, and we don't know what he will say about subsequent market behaviour."
